 Taylor Sheridan continues his run as one of the most successful creators in the TV world, with multiple series adding new seasons and spinning off into new projects . This year, the Tulsa King universe is expanding into its first spin-off, Frisco King , while the Yellowstone universe is still running with new seasons of Marshals and Dutton Ranch . Also on Sheridan's busy schedule is the hit Paramount+ series Lioness , which gives Zoe Saldaña a chance to shine in a new action franchise.
 This series is inspired by a real program in the CIA, as Lioness ' fictionalized CIA program deploys female undercover operatives to infiltrate high-level networks of terrorists and cartel members. Saldaña has an A-list supporting cast around her for this series, including Nicole Kidman, Michael Kelly, Morgan Freeman, and more . This season put Saldaña's Joe McNamara into uncharted territory, as she had to navigate an abduction and the collapse of her home life while continuing her work at the CIA. Now that the season is over, the viewing numbers from these new episodes are officially in as well.
 Variety reported that the Lioness Season 3 finale garnered 9.7 million viewers in its first seven days on Paramount+. This is not only the most-watched episode in the series' history but also the fifth-most-watched finale of any Paramount+ original show. Lioness averaged 8.5 million viewers per week throughout Season 3, a 62% increase over Season 2's weekly average two years ago.

 Just like so many of Sheridan's other projects, Lioness has only grown in popularity since its third season, setting records for Paramount+ in the process. The season even ended with a few major twists , particularly with the reveal that Stephanie Nur's Aaliyah Amrohi, the original target from Lioness ' first season, was the mastermind behind Joe's kidnapping in Season 3. Hoping to find revenge against the Lioness team, she helped set the stage for a major cliffhanger as the show waits for new episodes.
 As of writing, Lioness is not yet confirmed for a fourth season . However, this should not be a reason to worry, as new seasons typically take a long time to be renewed. Most recently, Season 3 was not greenlit for production for 10 months following the end of Season 2. Should this renewal come through, the stakes will only grow, especially with Aaliyah looking to draw the entire Lioness team out of the country and Joe doing what she can to get her family back.
